profiles.amortization_scope: profiler lifetime includes real prepared preflight, setup/probes and controlled load; raw time windows retained

cpu.interpretation: Exclusive user callchain buckets in listed precedence, clipped to the controlled load window. Pool includes admission/handoff bookkeeping; cancellation includes repeated control polling. Kernel execution and unresolved/inlined ancestors limit attribution. Shares are not isolated marginal elapsed costs.
